```
&INPUT kinematic
  Wmin=1.55, Wmax=1.75, nW=3,
  Q2min=0.5, Q2max=1.5, nQ2=3,
  costheta=0.0, phi=90.0,
  channel='ETA'
/

&INPUT grid
  gridtype='3x3'
  vars='W,Q2'
/

```
